entries.daf6e763b99fc667: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that since its founding the company has mainly been engaged in the design, construction and maintenance management of air-conditioning and water supply, drainage and sanitation equipment works, centered in Ibaraki Prefecture. The business is divided into the Facilities Business, the Solar Power Generation Business and Other Business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥9,135 million. Facility works consist of building equipment works, renewal works, civil engineering works, plant works and building care works. Revenue from construction orders is recorded according to the progress of the work (a method of recognizing revenue over a period). The company has no consolidated subsidiaries and discloses only its non-consolidated financial statements. The section on the status of related companies lists Hikari Tsushin, Inc. as an other related company.
entries.e8c8cf4c89f28784: A reportable segment engaged in the design and construction of equipment work such as air conditioning and plumbing and sanitation, and the maintenance and management of equipment and machinery; of the three reportable segments, it is the one with the largest revenue from external customers. The Annual Securities Report describes it as a business covering equipment work in general, including building equipment work, renovation work, civil engineering work, plant work, and building care work. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, orders received for construction were ¥10,203 million (up 19.3% from the previous fiscal year), completed construction revenue was ¥8,944 million (up 3.6%), and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥1,538 million (up 34.3%). The Annual Securities Report gives the increase in completed construction revenue and the improvement in the construction profit margin as the reasons for the increase in profit.
